# Bid the surfaces, not the floor plan.

> Price an interior painting job from production rates: walls, ceilings, trim, and doors — plus paint, payroll burden, overhead, and the walk-away number. See why a $2 per square foot floor bid loses money.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
